blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday called on law enforcers to ensure the safe conduct of arrest of Sen. Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa. “To our law enforcers, they must conduct a safe arrest of Senator Bato. No violence should happen,” Gatchalian said in an interview with radio dzBB. “It’s important that Senator Bato as well as our law enforcers, are safe because we know these kinds of operations are dangerous. It’s important to have an orderly arrest,” he added. “Based on what I heard in the news, particularly coming from the [Department of Interior and Local Government], violence […]...
